children: Largo shares were sharply lower Friday after the company priced its $5.7 million offering below recent trading prices.
Shares fell 24% in Toronto to 74 Canadian cents (52 cents) and 25% in New York to 51 cents.
The vanadium producer on Friday said it would offer 10.2 million units at a price of 56 cents apiece.
Each unit is made up of one share and a full warrant to acquire a share in the company at an exercisable price of 70 cents a share at any time over the next five years.
Largo is looking to raise funds for working capital purposes, including to pay trade creditors, it said.
Shares have been under pressure in 2026, closing on Thursday at 69 cents a share, far below its 52-week high of $2.70 and reaching a 52-week low of 51 cents.
